correctness.rationale: At simple two-point spectra, Df is the Hermitian Schur multiplier with coefficients u,v,w∈[0,1], including complex off-diagonal phase. Convexity reduces the induced spectral norm to eight binary masks; all but (1,0,1)/(0,1,1) have gain ≤1. Extreme Hermitian unitaries yield max_{0≤s≤1}(s+√(4−3s²))/2=2/√3. Integrate derivative along Hermitian segment, mollify nonsmooth monotone f and use positive-part perturbations near diag(1,−ε) for sharpness. L=0 and repeated eigenvalues covered.
